response.sql:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
aggregate_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as num_observatories,
    CAST(SUM(telescope_count) AS FLOAT) as total_count,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM telescope_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / a.total_count as share,
    (CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / a.total_count) - a.avg_share as difference_from_avg
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN aggregate_stats a
)
SELECT observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference_from_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM aggregate_stats)
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only observatory stations that have at least one telescope are counted when calculating average share. Observatory stations in the observatories table with zero telescopes are excluded from the count of observatories.

alternatives.interpretation: All observatories from the observatories table are included in the observatory count when calculating average share, even those with zero telescopes. This would lower the average share threshold and potentially change which observatories meet the 'above average' criterion.
alternatives.sql:
WITH all_observatories AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT observstation FROM observatories
),
telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count
  FROM all_observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
aggregate_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as num_observatories,
    CAST(SUM(telescope_count) AS FLOAT) as total_count,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM telescope_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CASE WHEN a.total_count > 0 THEN CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / a.total_count ELSE 0 END as share,
    (CASE WHEN a.total_count > 0 THEN CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / a.total_count ELSE 0 END) - a.avg_share as difference_from_avg
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN aggregate_stats a
)
SELECT observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference_from_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM aggregate_stats)
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
